question: An interviewer says: "Given an array of up to 100,000 numbers, return the length of the longest stretch whose sum is at most K. All numbers are positive." What should you notice first?
options: Contiguous stretch + positive numbers + a limit: a sliding window fits in O(n)
Try every start and end: n is small
It needs dynamic programming over all subsets
explanation: "Stretch" means contiguous, and positive numbers mean the sum only grows as the window widens, so a window can grow and shrink in one pass. n = 100,000 rules out O(n²).
